name: LeaveWell: Move Out Checklist
subtitle: Rental inventory & photo proof
promotionalText: Make your next move feel more manageable. Organise room photos, final meter readings and key handover details, then share a clear PDF evidence report.
description:
Moving out comes with enough to remember. LeaveWell helps you organise your rental checkout, document the property and keep the evidence together, one room at a time.

Built for renters preparing to leave a home in England, LeaveWell brings your move-out checklist, property inventory, photos, notes and final handover records into one calm place.

A PLAN YOU CAN WORK THROUGH
Follow a dated move-out checklist, from reviewing your original inventory to photographing each room and recording your key handover. Mark tasks complete after you have checked them, and enable reminders for upcoming tasks.

ROOM-BY-ROOM PHOTO EVIDENCE
Start with a whole-room photograph, then check walls, floors, windows and fixtures. Add photos, video, typed notes or voice recordings to describe what you actually observed. Keep your descriptions factual and your records easy to find.

YOUR RENTAL DOCUMENTS, TOGETHER
Import the original inventory, cleaning receipts and checkout correspondence, or scan paper documents. Search evidence labels, notes and room names when you need a particular record. Review your move-in documents alongside your move-out evidence and write your own comparison notes.

FINAL READINGS AND KEY HANDOVER
Record electricity, gas and water meter readings. Where supported, on-device text recognition can suggest a reading for you to check; you confirm the final value. Log keys and fobs, quantities, handover dates, methods and recipients.

A CLEAR PDF EVIDENCE REPORT
Choose the evidence to include, review your sharing controls and generate a structured PDF with room records, readings, access items and supporting documents. Preview it, save it or share it using the native share sheet. Contact and deposit details are optional.

PRIVATE, ON YOUR DEVICE
No account is needed. Records are stored on your device, with an optional biometric or device-passcode app lock. OCR and supported speech transcription run on device. Original files are checked before preview and export, and captured, imported and updated times stay separate.

You control what you document and share. Records are excluded from automatic device backups, so export anything you need to keep. Shared copies remain with their recipients.

LeaveWell helps you prepare an organised record. It does not provide legal advice, decide responsibility for property condition or guarantee the return of a tenancy deposit.

Move out organised. Leave with the evidence.
reviewNotes:
LeaveWell is a local, account-free move-out record app. No sign-in or demo credentials are required.

Review flow: complete the four onboarding screens, create a property, choose rooms, then open a room to add photos, notes or files. The property screen also links to the move-out checklist, meters, keys, document vault, manual inventory comparison, evidence search, timeline and PDF report.

Camera, microphone, speech and notification access are optional and requested only for the corresponding action. Photos are selected through the system picker. If on-device speech transcription is unavailable, typed notes and saved audio remain available. Meter OCR suggestions must be confirmed by the user.

In Settings, app lock uses the device's available biometrics or passcode. Records are kept on device and excluded from automatic backups; users can export their records. The report is a shareable snapshot and warns that recipients may keep copies.

The assistant offers deterministic guidance based on the user's records; no remote generative AI or backend is used. The current edition has no enabled in-app purchases, cloud sync or collaboration.

App Store screenshots use clearly labelled fictional demonstration records. The screenshot fixture and capture routes are compiled only into Debug, not Release.
